prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1236; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This is a recorded statement regarding the sideswipe collision you reported. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving in League City, Texas, on the main road heading toward the freeway. I was trying to move into the right lane because I needed to make an exit.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you were changing lanes.

A: I checked my mirror and saw the lane looked clear, so I signaled and started to move over. Then I felt a bump on my passenger side and heard scraping. The other car had been in my blind spot, and I didn't see it until we made contact.

Q: Did you come to a stop after the impact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. I stayed in the car for a minute because my neck and lower back already felt stiff.

Q: Were you taken to a medical facility?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. They told me I had neck and back strain and gave me some medication and instructions to rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, my neck is sore when I turn my head, and my lower back aches after sitting for long periods. I'm going to a physical therapy appointment next week.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
